comment:
Android provides shared storage at `/storage/emulated/0/Plasma` through MediaProvider FUSE. `rungic-plasma-enter` binds it to `/mnt/plasma-shared`. The container configuration, `system/plasma.config`, binds it to `/mnt/android-shared`.

`system/shared-storage` (`rungic-plasma-shared.service`) mounts this storage again with bindfs as the desktop account's `~/Shared`. The account owns this writable mount. It supports shared writable mmap for SQLite WAL. See `docs/69`.

The Linux consumer is `system/user-dirs`, installed as `/usr/libexec/rungic-user-dirs`. The session and `account-prepare` run it. It refuses an unmounted `~/Shared`.

It creates standard shared directories there. It creates `~/NAME -> Shared/NAME` links unless the user already has their own. It sets the XDG directory mapping. Programs then save files in these directories. Screen recordings use Videos.

The provider check only reads mounts, links and write permissions. It uses `access(2)` to check permissions without writing files.

`tools/tests/test_contract_shared_storage.py` checks the real `user-dirs` against a substitute mount. Acceptance scenario `contract.shared-storage` checks the provider.

queries.name: user-dirs
queries.command: for d in Downloads Music Pictures Videos Templates Public; do [ -L "$HOME/$d" ] || continue; [ "$(readlink -f "$HOME/$d")" = "$(readlink -f "$HOME/Shared/$d")" ] || { echo "$d does not lead into Shared"; exit 1; }; done; [ "$(xdg-user-dir VIDEOS)" = "$HOME/Videos" ] && [ "$(xdg-user-dir DOWNLOAD)" = "$HOME/Downloads" ]
